name: Two-observation dumbbell
reader_question: How did each entity change between two comparable observations?
relationship: Paired observations per entity on a shared axis; the gap is the change.
use_when: Both observations use the same population, definition and unit
The size of each change matters more than the rank
avoid_when: More than two time points — use annotated-line or small-multiples
The second value is a target or forecast — mark it as such or use evidence-milestone-strip

data_contract.notes: Names of the two observations (for example period labels)
Shared axis maximum; must cover every value

units: One unit and population for both observations; axis starts at zero.

editable: Every dot, connector and label is a native shape or text box (move, recolour, retype)
not_data_bound: Positions are computed from the fixture; changing a value means moving the shape or re-running the renderer — there is no Edit Data

table_alternative: A three-column table (entity, first, second, change) when exact values are needed.
variations: Slope chart (slope) when rank reversal is the point
Paired bars (grouped-bar) for two series with few entities
limitations: Endpoints are observations; the connector does not represent the path between them

excluded_alternatives.reason: Cannot show per-entity change and compares angles across charts
